analysis: Documentation-only changes. docs/developer/build.md (patch hunk head 162-184) documents the release toolchain selection: it moves SDK 27.0 to 27.2, adds a release vs qualification mode table, and says an explicit DEVELOPER_DIR is the only candidate. docs/developer/test.md (head lines 1049-1050) updates the SDK 27 release qualification line to SDK 27.2 / Swift 6.4.2. The supplied head text of build.md (lines 488-708) is unchanged context: runtime-smoke instructions, Flint build, cluster qualification notes. I did not find any change to the runtime security controls in TB-002/TB-003/TB-007/TB-009/TB-011, the cache posture in T-041, or the key and attestation handling. The unit 67373c0eff1153bd:0 has no text. The test.md base excerpt (lines 1-456) predates the change and does not include the changed line. Unverified: the described script behavior (scripts/prepare-provider-release-toolchain.sh, the qualification vs release modes, and the fallback of accepting SDK 27.0 for qualification) is outside the supplied evidence. The scripts and workflows (release-provider.yml, provider-signing-validation.yml) were not supplied, so whether the release path is strictly pinned to SDK 27.2 cannot be confirmed. If the scripts actually let release builds fall back to a different SDK, that would touch the build-provenance contract (A-011/A-017, T-034/T-054). That is a question for the pass that reviews the script changes, not a finding here.
